subject: Renewal: 2027 term & capacity uplift — procurement onboarding refresh
messages:
From: Cassie Nguyen <cassie@novanet.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T08:45:00Z
Subject: Renewal & capacity uplift — initial procurement intake

Hi Irene,

Quick note from procurement at NovaNet — our platform footprint doubled this year and leadership is ready to move forward on a renewal + capacity uplift for calendar 2027. We want to refresh vendor onboarding artifacts to match our security and billing gates before legal signs the amendment.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide an updated onboarding packet (vendor form, SOC2 attestation, current SOW delta) and a clear list of procurement portal steps so we can route to our Finance ops?

We’re targeting an effective date of 2027-01-01 and a committed capacity uplift of ~2x. I’ve looped in David (PO lead) and we can start with your vendor form attached.

Thanks — Cassie
Cassie Nguyen
Director, Strategic Sourcing
NovaNet Analytics
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF - 1.2MB)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Cassie Nguyen <cassie@novanet.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity uplift — initial procurement intake

Hi Cassie — great to hear and congrats on the growth. Happy to run this through our standard renewal onboarding checklist and accelerate the procurement handoff.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- I’ll attach our vendor intake packet and a short checklist for the procurement portal flow.
- Marissa (CS lead on this account) will scope the SOW delta and capacity numbers so legal has a clean change order.
- If NovaNet can send a PO intent or estimated spend band, our Finance team will create a pre-approved PO path to reduce gate time.

I’m attaching the vendor intake and have copied Marissa to own the SOW draft. I’ll also share the HubSpot renewal record and a DocuSign room link for signatures.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Manager — Renewals
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_vendor_intake.pdf (PDF - 600KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Cassie Nguyen <cassie@novanet.com>; Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:05:00Z
Subject: Procurement portal steps + evidence checklist for NovaNet renewal

Hi Cassie — Jordan from Sales Ops here, stepping in to lay out the exact procurement path so your Finance team can move quickly.

Portal & evidence steps (recommended fast-track):
1) Upload vendor intake packet to our procurement portal (link below). Please fill the vendor tax and contact sections; that unlocks the PO lane.
2) Upload SOC2 report and current system diagram (we accept PDF). If SOC2 is in progress, provide the last assessment letter + remediation plan.
3) Confirm SOW delta spreadsheet (Marissa will share a version) and estimated committed spend band.
4) Attach PO intent (PDF or internal PO #) and a billing contact to enable invoicing pre-approval.

I’m attaching a SOW delta draft and a PO intent template — fill the template and re-upload. Once the portal shows "complete" our Finance team issues an internal clearance and we’ll route to legal for a change order.

Portal link: https://procure.redwood.com/portal/upload?company=novanet
HubSpot renewal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (renewal record DN-2026-4957)

Attachments: SOW_delta_2027.docx, PO_intent_template.xlsx

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_delta_2027.docx (DOCX - 42KB)]

Date: 2026-09-02T15:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity uplift — procurement onboarding refresh

Thanks — we completed the portal upload this morning and attached a PO intent. The portal shows the vendor intake and SOC2 letter are uploaded. I attached the PO intent PDF and an internal FCC clearance note. Let me know if you need an updated SOW table.

High-level: PO intent attached, target signature week: 2026-09-09. Committed uplift: 2.1x (preliminary).

Attaching: PO_intent_novanet_Sept.pdf

David Patel
Procurement Manager
NovaNet Analytics
